posts.title: For the fairest
posts.author: Eris
posts.body:
hi everyone!! long time reader, first time poster. i have a small present and i would like to give it to the most beautiful person on this forum. it is a golden apple and it says KALLISTI on it which means "for the fairest"

i will leave it right here in the thread

anyone can take it

go ahead

posts.author: Achilles
posts.body:
You did this at my parents' wedding. My mother still does not talk about it. A goddess threw a piece of fruit into a party and a few decades later I was dead and a city was on fire.

Mods.

posts.author: Eris
posts.body:
i was NOT invited to that wedding, which you will notice nobody ever brings up

anyway it is just an apple. nobody has to fight over it. unless someone thinks they deserve it more than someone else. which would be interesting

posts.author: Circe
posts.body: It is a very nice apple.

posts.author: Athena
posts.body:
Thread locked, apple confiscated, Eris banned. Again.

Circe, consider yourself warned. I have been through this once, and I lost to Aphrodite on a technicality involving a bribe. I will not be relitigating it on my own forum.
